title: 3 Questions You Will Be Asked in the Grave

lines.text: You will be asked 3 questions in the grave, and you never get a second chance.
lines.title: 3 QUESTIONS

lines.text: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: when you are buried, you hear the footsteps of the people walking away.
Then two angels come, and sit you up.
Who is this man who was sent among you?
lines.card: Who is this man who was sent among you?

lines.text: The believer answers. And a caller from the heavens says: My servant has spoken the truth.
But the other one says: Alas, alas. I do not know.
You cannot study for this exam in the grave. You answer it with your life.
So the Prophet, peace be upon him, used to ask Allah for protection from the punishment of the grave.
Because one day, it will be you who hears them walking away.

sources: Sahih al-Bukhari 1338 (footsteps; two angels sit the person up): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:1338
Sunan Abi Dawud 4753, Sahih (Al-Albani) (the 3 questions; 'My servant has spoken the truth'; 'Alas, alas, I do not know'): https://sunnah.com/abudawud:4753
Sahih al-Bukhari 1377 (the Prophet's du'a for protection from the punishment of the grave): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:1377

chosen: You will be asked 3 questions in the grave, and you never get a second chance. What are they?
alternative: Nobody can help you answer these 3 questions in the grave. So why not learn them before you die?
hook_scores.why: The alternative scored higher but reads as a lecture in the first second; the chosen hook confirms the title, raises the question, and the visual answers it inside 10 seconds.

loop: The last line ('...hears them walking away') runs straight back into the first frame of the graveyard, so a replay feels continuous.
